verdicts.reason: Confirmed. ipc.ts:51-61 sets experimentalRequested from the flag before it checks the platform, and recorder-engine.ts:430-433 then reports the fallback. Now that the default is true, every Windows/Linux take hits this path: dev builds show a 10 s toast and packaged builds log a misleading 'Experimental native capture' line.

True, and this PR causes it: packaged builds now only console.info the fallback reason, and the console is not collected. Now that native is the default, a missing helper or a failed preparation in the wild leaves no trace in telemetry. Fair to ask whether those error cases should go to captureEvent.

Confirmed in analytics-client.ts:77-79: when PostHog has not started (diagnostics off, no key) or returns undefined, the fallback, now true, applies. Those users cannot be switched off remotely, so the doc's 'Every build reads false' overclaims the kill switch.
Too minor. 'Frame' is the label users see, and the backlog banner already states the watermark exception. The table row is only a summary.

ADR 0047 still says the flag is off (line 21), sets an owner gate for turning it on, and lists 'Turning the flag on' as a non-goal (line 117). This PR turns the flag on without updating the ADR or confirming the gate, which conflicts with the repo's rule that docs stay honest.
The doc comment right above the changed default still says 'experiments stay off', which this PR makes false. It is a one-line fix. The complaint about the test name is weaker.
